requirements.name: NMC eligibility / qualification check
requirements.detail: Create an NMC account and submit qualification evidence.

requirements.name: English language evidence (IELTS/OET)
requirements.detail: IELTS Academic 7.0 or OET grade B, or an approved alternative.

requirements.name: CBT (Computer Based Test) — Test of Competence
OSCE — Objective Structured Clinical Examination
requirements.detail: Part 2 practical exam, sat in the UK.
depends_on: CBT (Computer Based Test) — Test of Competence

requirements.name: NMC registration decision
requirements.detail: Final registration once CBT, OSCE and language are met.

notes: Two-part Test of Competence (CBT then OSCE) is distinct from the North American NCLEX model.
